intendedCoverage.scopeNotes: 151,157 records - consistent with the full register between the 2017 FOI (135,866) and the 2023-02-20 publication (152,084).

reconstructionNotes: Recovered from the maintainer's Amateur-Radio-Callsign-Browser repository (commit 3075df0, 2023-05-10, 'Add call sign data, available and re-used under the Open Government Licence v3'; path at commit: 'data/archive/amateur-callsigns -- 2022.05.30.csv'). That repository holds two downloads of this dataset - filenames dated 2022-05-30 and 2022-07-26 - which are byte-identical, so Ofcom's publication predates 2022-05-30 and was unchanged for at least two months. Ofcom's own publication date is unknown; the earliest observed download date (2022-05-30) is used as the archive key, and fetchedAt records that date at midnight UTC for want of a finer timestamp. Oldest known header variant (Value,Status,Type - no product, no dates).
